appNodes: <ChatStream key={sessionId ?? workspaceDir} entries={entries} onQuickAction={requestOpenKind} activity={chatActivity} navigationOpen={questionNavOpen} onNavigationClose={() => setQuestionNavOpen(false)} />

<Composer
							client={client}
							connected={connected}
							disabled={running || submitting || !connected}
							running={running}
							onSend={(text) => void sendPrompt(text)}
							onAbort={() => void abort()}
							providers={providers}
							model={modelValue}
							onModel={handleModelChange}
							thinkingLevel={thinkingLevel}
							onThinkingLevel={handleThinkingChange}
							approvalMode={approvalMode}
							onApprovalMode={handleApprovalModeChange}
							sessionInfo={sessionInfo}
							workspaceDir={workspaceDir}
							projects={projects}
							onSwitchProject={switchProject}
							commands={slashCommands}
						/>
